resources.string: Native: System EGL · 60 Hz. Container: Zink/Turnip (Adreno GPU) uses host Zink with dmabuf; LLVMpipe (CPU) uses host System EGL with native buffers. No renderer fallback. End the session using App Stop; session logout and save are unavailable.
Zink/Turnip: container GPU rendering, host Zink display with dmabuf buffers. LLVMpipe: container CPU rendering, host System EGL display with native buffers. Startup stops if the selected path fails.
